subject: Kickoff: MAP skeleton + week0 ops checklist and evaluation heartbeat
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Ellis <simon.ellis@stellarnet.ai>, Lara Nguyen <lara@stellarnet.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: MAP skeleton + week0 ops checklist and evaluation heartbeat

Hi Simon / Lara —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Per our conversation, I sketched a compact MAP (mutual action plan) focused on a 30-day evaluation with an accelerated week0 checklist so you can validate inference latency and integration points quickly. Goal here is to set expectations and surface the minimal operational items to get a meaningful test running in 7–10 days.

Key pieces in the draft (linked below):
- Outcome & success metrics (latency targets, cost per 1k tokens, acceptance tests)
- Week0 ops checklist (networking, KMS, infra access, sample dataset)
- Technical validation plan (end-to-end smoke tests, perf profile, error budget)
- Stakeholder RACI and weekly checkpoints

Action items I recommend for this week:
1) Review the MAP doc and add any missing stakeholders or constraints
2) Simon / Lara: confirm a 2-hour sandbox slot for Wed next week for an initial integration demo
3) Marissa / Ben: I'll need a short slide (2–3) covering trial gating & pricing guardrails to share with their procurement team

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcdEFgHIjKLmnoPqRST/edit (MAP_quickstart_template.gdoc)
Attached: week0-ops-slides.pptx (stub)

Let me know if you'd prefer we run a workshop instead of a single demo — we can swap the week0 checklist for a 3-hour working session.

Thanks,
Jasmine
---
Jasmine Liu | Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
Cc: Simon Ellis <simon.ellis@stellarnet.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP skeleton + week0 ops checklist and evaluation heartbeat

On Thu, May 28, 2026 at 9:12 AM Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Simon / Lara —
> 
> Thanks again for the time earlier....

Thanks for the draft, Jas — this is a clean start. A few quick notes inline and a couple of asks below. I'll paste short comments in the doc as well.

Quick edits I recommend now:
- Move "Acceptance tests" up under outcomes and make the first acceptance item a single smoke test (generate -> validate tokenization -> measure 95th perc latency)
- Add procurement milestone: "T&Cs review window" (we typically allow 3 business days for simple SaaS addendum review)
- Add a rollback/fallback plan bullet for the demo in case of region throttles (route to replica model in us-west-2)

Asks for Ben: can you draft the two pricing bullets for the week0 deck — (1) trial unit limits and (2) overage guardrail — I'll paste them into the slides.

Simon: does StellarNet have an internal SLA or throughput target you want us to aim for during the pilot (e.g., 50 qps steady-state)? That will help finalize the perf profile.

I'll update the doc by EOD with comments.

Cheers,
Marissa

Marissa Cole | Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks team — good start. A couple quick clarifications from our side:
- Throughput target: we'd like to validate ~40 qps for the core NLU route with 512 tokens (p50 latency target <= 200ms, p95 <= 450ms)
- Sandbox window: Wed next week (6/2) from 10:00–12:00 UK time works for our engineers

Also, procurement will need an outline of data handling (we are regulated in EU, but pilot will be hosted in our US account). Please add a short paragraph on where logs are stored and retention defaults.

Happy to keep comments light in the doc; if it helps, we can do a 30-min pre-demo tech sync on Tue.

Simon
Simon Ellis | Head of Platform | StellarNet
